verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth, global and China endpoints, a quickstart for calling the API service, a dated /v1 changelog, and per-unit pricing for text-to-video and image-to-video, so submitting video jobs programmatically is clearly supported. The pack never shows the job lifecycle: no task-status polling, no callback, and no download URL for retrieving the finished asset. There is also no sandbox or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented task-status/result-retrieval endpoint or asset download flow, async job lifecycle details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
